* [[Darth Vader (V)]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon.
* To fully utilize [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s text, pair him with a Black Squadron pilot:
* [[DS-61-2]]
* [[DS-61-3]]
* [[DS-61-4]]
* [[DS-61-5]]
* [[Reserve Pilot]]
* Any character (not permanent pilot) piloting a Black Squadron starship
|rulings=* Permanent pilots (e.g. [[Black 11]]) never count as Black Squadron.<ref name="scomp" />
* Any pilot character (e.g. [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]) becomes a Black Squadron pilot while they are piloting a Black Squadron starship.
* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] only looks for ''your'' Black Squadron pilot, not an opponent's Black Squadron pilot.
